general.name: Immediate Scam Safety
steps: Stop communicating with the suspicious person.
Do not send any more money.
Do not share OTP, UPI PIN, ATM PIN, password or CVV.
Do not install remote-access software.
Do not approve unknown payment requests.
Do not scan a QR code because someone told you to receive money.
Contact your bank or service provider through an official channel.
Tell a trusted family member or person you trust.
Keep screenshots, messages, phone numbers and transaction details as evidence.

otp_shared.name: OTP Shared
steps: Stop the conversation immediately.
Do not share any further OTP or authentication code.
Contact your bank immediately using its official customer-care number.
Ask the bank to check for unauthorized transactions or account changes.
If money has been lost or unauthorized banking activity has occurred, report it through India's official cybercrime reporting channels.
Change affected passwords if appropriate.
Tell a trusted family member or person you trust.

upi_pin_shared.name: UPI PIN Shared
steps: Stop the call or conversation.
Do not approve any additional payment request.
Contact your bank immediately through an official channel.
Check recent UPI and bank transactions.
If you notice an unauthorized transaction, report it immediately.
If your UPI PIN may have been exposed, change it using your legitimate banking or UPI application.
Tell a trusted family member or person you trust.

atm_pin_shared.name: ATM / Card PIN Shared
steps: Stop communicating with the caller.
Contact the card-issuing bank immediately.
Ask the bank to secure the card/account.
Change the affected PIN through an official banking channel.
Check recent transactions for unauthorized activity.
Report suspicious transactions immediately.
Do not provide any additional card information.

password_shared.name: Password Shared
steps: Stop communicating with the suspicious person.
Change the exposed password using the official website or application.
Do not reuse the exposed password on another account.
Enable multi-factor authentication where available.
Review recent account activity.
If the exposed password was also used for banking or email, secure those accounts immediately.

remote_access_granted.name: Remote Access Granted
steps: Disconnect the suspicious remote-access session.
If necessary, disconnect the device from the internet.
Uninstall the remote-access application if it is not legitimately required.
Contact your bank through an official channel if banking applications or accounts were accessible.
Change important passwords from a trusted device.
Check bank, UPI and email activity for unauthorized changes.
Consider getting help from a trusted technical person.

money_sent.name: Money Sent to Suspected Scammer
steps: Contact your bank or payment provider immediately.
Ask whether the transaction can be stopped, frozen or recalled.
Keep the transaction ID, amount, date and recipient details.
Report the incident through India's official cybercrime reporting channels.
Preserve screenshots, messages, phone numbers, emails and other evidence.
Do not send additional money to anyone promising to recover the lost money.

card_details_shared.name: Card Details Shared
steps: Contact the card-issuing bank immediately.
Ask the bank to secure or block the affected card if necessary.
Monitor recent transactions.
Do not provide OTP, CVV, PIN or additional card information.
Report unauthorized transactions immediately.

suspicious_app_installed.name: Suspicious Application Installed
steps: Do not open or use the suspicious application again.
Disconnect from the internet if you believe the device is being remotely controlled.
Remove the application if it is safe to do so.
Check whether accessibility, device-admin or other powerful permissions were granted.
Contact your bank if banking information may have been exposed.
Change important passwords from a trusted device.
Ask a trusted technical person for help if you are unsure how to secure the device.

digital_arrest.name: Possible Digital-Arrest Scam
steps: End the call.
Do not remain on a video call because the caller demands it.
Do not transfer money to a so-called safe, verification or police account.
Do not share OTP, PIN or password.
Do not install remote-access software.
Verify any legal or government claim independently using an official source.
Tell a trusted family member or person you trust.

qr_payment.name: Suspicious QR / Payment Request
steps: Do not scan the QR code unless you understand exactly what it will do.
Remember that scanning a QR code can initiate a payment flow; it does not automatically mean you will receive money.
Do not enter your UPI PIN to receive money.
Check the recipient name and amount before approving any payment.
Cancel the transaction if anything looks unexpected.

job_scam.name: Possible Job Scam
steps: Do not pay a registration, security, training or processing fee because of an unexpected job offer.
Do not share banking credentials or OTP.
Verify the employer independently.
Use the employer's official website rather than a link supplied by the caller.

investment_scam.name: Possible Investment Scam
steps: Do not transfer money during a pressured investment call.
Do not trust guaranteed or unusually high returns without independent verification.
Do not give remote access to your device.
Verify the company and investment through independent official sources.

courier_scam.name: Possible Courier Scam
steps: Do not pay a caller who claims that a parcel must be cleared urgently.
Do not share OTP, PIN or banking credentials.
Do not install applications at the caller's request.
Verify any parcel claim independently using the courier's official website or customer-care channel.

bank_kyc.name: Possible Bank / KYC Scam
steps: Do not click a suspicious KYC link.
Do not share OTP, PIN, password or CVV.
Do not install an application sent by the caller.
Contact the bank using the number on its official website, card or legitimate banking application.
Check your account through the official banking application or website.

recovery_scam.name: Possible Recovery Scam
steps: Do not pay anyone who promises guaranteed recovery of stolen money.
Do not give remote access to your device.
Do not share OTP, PIN or password.
Use official banking and cybercrime reporting channels for recovery assistance.
Keep all evidence from the original scam.

guidance: For financial fraud, contact your bank or payment provider immediately.
Use India's official cybercrime reporting and emergency channels when appropriate.
Preserve transaction IDs and other evidence.
Do not rely on unofficial social-media accounts claiming to recover money.
india_reporting.important_note: ElderShield provides guidance and does not replace official law-enforcement, banking or emergency services.
